subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the face showing the number '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea143503604ed5967694dbfeb427b99506f9e37d147fee2be10cf679c00c2864.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 is common on both the dice, it is clear that 1, 2, 3 and 4 are adjacent to it and remaining number i.e., 6 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de1cd28cb3338537e7f9a7440068e84bd94d07cbb0a679313d27d2bf3d5d5934.png] 

Opposite pairs:

1 → 2

3 → 4

5 → 6

So, the opposite side of "6" will be side "5".

Hence, the correct answer is "5".
